adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in handleCancelBooking.ts, the code now iterates over multiple calendar references (line 418-419 changes from find to filter). Inside the loop starting at line 421, when handling recurring events (lines 432-455), the code runs the same deletion logic for ALL credentials that end with '_calendar' for EACH calendar reference in the outer loop. This means if there are N calendar references and M calendar credentials, the recurring event deletion promises will be created N*M times instead of just M times, causing duplicate delete requests. The nested loop structure (for reference of calendarReference -> for credential of credentials -> for updBooking of updatedBookings) creates redundant API calls.
